diagrams.title: From lead to documented recovery
diagrams.subtitle: Five gates, not a promise of payment
diagrams.assumptions_note: Ordinal numeric values indicate sequence, not elapsed time or success probability.
diagrams.caption: Identify the legal lane before researching relatives or offering a recovery contract.

stages.label: Classify
stages.detail: Separate probate, custodial unclaimed property and sale surplus.

stages.label: Qualify
stages.detail: Verify the record, claimant eligibility, deadlines and likely net value.

stages.label: Prove
stages.detail: Build a sourced relationship chain and resolve contradictory records.

stages.label: Authorize
stages.detail: Obtain lawful consent and locally reviewed contractual authority.

stages.label: Resolve
stages.detail: Submit through the authorized channel and reconcile actual distributions.

diagrams.title: A qualification funnel worth measuring
diagrams.subtitle: Illustrative cohort of 100 records
diagrams.assumptions_note: Invented nested cohort; these counts are not observed conversion rates or a forecast.
diagrams.caption: Measure why records leave each gate; signed clients and completed distributions are different outcomes.

stages.label: Records screened
stages.detail: Deduplicated records with identifiable custodians or case numbers.

stages.label: Plausible net value
stages.detail: Illustrative survivors after preliminary eligibility and liability checks.

stages.label: Evidence feasible
stages.detail: A credible document path exists within a defined research budget.

stages.label: Authorized clients
stages.detail: Eligible claimants choose assistance under lawful agreements.

stages.label: Paid resolutions
stages.detail: Actual collected fees, potentially many months after intake.

diagrams.title: What remains of a collected fee
diagrams.subtitle: Business contribution, not the estate distribution
diagrams.assumptions_note: USD; first and last bars are totals, middle bars are signed deductions. Assumed lawful fee is $6,000 on $60,000 recovered.
diagrams.caption: A $6,000 fee less $1,200 records, $800 review and $1,000 allocated acquisition leaves $3,000 before overhead, owner pay and tax.

stages.label: Collected fee
stages.detail: Opening total: a hypothetical 10% fee, only if lawful for this claim.

stages.label: Records and research
stages.detail: Direct evidence costs, including paid research labor.

stages.label: Professional review
stages.detail: Business-paid review; not an asserted statutory charge.

stages.label: Acquisition allocation
stages.detail: Allocated costs include unsuccessful leads, not just this winner.

stages.label: Contribution
stages.detail: Closing total, not an additional movement and not owner net profit.

diagrams.title: Fee-cap sensitivity before choosing a market
diagrams.subtitle: Hypothetical legal ceilings, not a state-law comparison
diagrams.assumptions_note: Percent of a $40,000 recovery. A-D are hypothetical jurisdictions; no bar states an actual legal limit. Replace only after current legal review.
diagrams.caption: Identical recoveries can support different maximum fees; timing restrictions can make an agreement unavailable regardless of percentage.

stages.label: Hypothetical A
stages.detail: Assumed ceiling only; agreement eligibility still requires review.

stages.label: Hypothetical B
stages.detail: Assumed ceiling, not a recommendation to charge the maximum.

stages.label: Hypothetical C
stages.detail: Assumed ceiling; the allowable compensation base may differ.

stages.label: Hypothetical D
stages.detail: Assumed ceiling; expense reimbursement can also be regulated.

diagrams.title: Build proof before naming an heir
diagrams.subtitle: A research triage tree, not a distribution formula
diagrams.assumptions_note: Numeric values identify nodes. Edges are stated in detail; local law decides succession, representation and shares.
diagrams.caption: Relationship evidence supports legal analysis; it does not replace a court's finding of entitlement.

stages.label: Governing instrument?
stages.detail: Valid will or trust: follow counsel's instrument analysis; otherwise continue to node 2.

stages.label: Spouse or descendants?
stages.detail: Yes: document and refer for allocation; no: continue to node 3. Spousal rights may coexist with descendants.

stages.label: Parents or collateral kin?
stages.detail: Yes: prove each link and refer for statutory priority; no or uncertain: continue to node 4.

stages.label: Evidence unresolved?
stages.detail: Stop distribution assumptions; obtain missing records and counsel's direction on further classes or escheat.

diagrams.title: Separate research, review and client care
diagrams.subtitle: Roles may be fractional; authority must remain distinct
diagrams.assumptions_note: Numeric values are role identifiers, not headcounts, hierarchy ranks or compensation.
diagrams.caption: The owner coordinates researchers and client care; independent licensed advisers retain professional judgment.

stages.label: Owner / case lead
stages.detail: Accountable for intake gates, budgets and secure case access.

stages.label: Research specialist
stages.detail: Reports case evidence to the lead; does not decide legal entitlement.

stages.label: Client coordinator
stages.detail: Reports to the lead; tracks consent, requests and plain-language updates.

stages.label: Independent counsel
stages.detail: Advises within a separate engagement; not controlled by a research sales target.

diagrams.title: A lean pilot's startup cash stack
diagrams.subtitle: Compare cost composition, not promised earnings
diagrams.assumptions_note: USD; one scenario with four additive components totaling $5,000. This is not a vendor quote or paired market comparison; living expenses are excluded.
diagrams.caption: Keep a reserve for failed cases and delays; a cheap subscription does not make the business fully funded.

stages.label: Setup and review
stages.detail: Illustrative formation, contract review and insurance allowance; obtain actual quotes.

stages.label: Research tools
stages.detail: Illustrative three-month subscriptions and basic secure working tools.

stages.label: Pilot case costs
stages.detail: Illustrative records, postage and limited paid research.

stages.label: Business reserve
stages.detail: Uncommitted buffer; owner living costs and taxes require a separate plan.

diagrams.title: Thirty days to a controlled pilot
diagrams.subtitle: Readiness milestones, not a collection deadline
diagrams.assumptions_note: Numeric values are milestone end-days; ranges are calendar targets, not statutory deadlines.
diagrams.caption: The first month should produce a reviewable process and documented cases, not an unsupported income promise.

stages.label: Choose the lane
stages.detail: Select one jurisdiction, custodian and claim type; get legal gates reviewed.

stages.label: Build the controls
stages.detail: Set record provenance, privacy, case budgets and written stop rules.

stages.label: Run a small cohort
stages.detail: Screen a bounded batch and build evidence only for qualified leads.

stages.label: Review and decide
stages.detail: Audit economics and compliance; continue, redesign or stop the pilot.
